title: Unified Data Object v1
description: Schema for a single resource's UDO file. Declares facts (fields, validation, relationships, UI hints) that drive code generation. Never describes logic.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema. Enables editor autocomplete and validation.

udoVersion.description: UDO schema version. Required so generators can branch on schema evolution.

resource.description: PascalCase resource name. e.g. 'Product', 'VerificationCode'. Drives class names, file names, and translation keys.

table.description: DB table name. If omitted, defaults to snake_case_plural of the resource.

softDeletes.description: Adds Laravel SoftDeletes trait + deleted_at column.

timestamps.description: Adds created_at and updated_at columns. Default true.

indexes.description: Composite indexes. Single-column indexes come from field-level `unique: true` (unique) or `index: true` (non-unique).

name.description: Custom index name; auto-derived if omitted.

controller.description: How the controller is generated. Default 'auto' produces a stock RESTful controller.

ownedBy.description: FK column tying each row to the authenticated user. Scopes index, forces the column on store, 404s non-owner access, and excludes the column from the FormRequest and TS write payloads.

transformer.description: How the API Resource transformer is generated.

request.description: How the FormRequest is generated. 'custom' keeps a hand-written request (skip regeneration) when validation carries logic the schema can't express (conditional rules, injected fields, auth).

factory.description: Whether to emit a Laravel factory.

nav.description: Optional sidebar entry. If omitted, the resource isn't auto-added to nav.

fields.description: Map of field name (snake_case) to field declaration.

relationships.description: Non-belongsTo relationships. belongsTo is inferred from foreignId fields.

appends.description: Computed accessor attributes appended to serialization (Laravel $appends). The accessor bodies live in the model extension (App\Models\{Resource}); declare their read-only type here so it flows to the API Resource and the frontend Shape.

views.description: Optional UI structure for form/table/card views. All optional with sensible defaults.

semanticFormat.description: Semantic flavor of the primitive type. Drives default UI widget and validation hints. Not all formats apply to all primitives.

index.description: Add a single-column non-unique index on this field.

default.description: Default value. Type depends on field type. Use null for explicit nullable default.

max.description: For strings: max length. For numbers: max value.

min.description: For strings: min length. For numbers: min value.

length.description: Exact length (e.g. for char(N) or string(N)).

references.description: For foreignId: 'table.column' the FK points at. Implies belongsTo relationship.

onDelete.description: FK onDelete behavior. Only applies to foreignId.

displayField.description: For foreignId: the related row's field shown in pickers and option labels. e.g. 'name'.

label.description: Translation key override. If omitted, convention is '{resource}.fields.{field_name}'.

hidden.description: Exclude this attribute from API serialization (Laravel $hidden). Dropped from the generated read Shape, but still writable on create/update (e.g. password).

cast.description: Override the inferred Eloquent cast, e.g. 'hashed', 'encrypted', 'encrypted:array'. Takes precedence over the type-derived cast.

validation.description: Escape hatches for FE/BE validation divergence. Use only when semantic facets aren't enough.

backend.description: Extra Laravel validation rules appended to the backend rules array (e.g. ['unique:users,email','exists:categories,id']).

frontend.description: Extra frontend-only rules appended to the FE rules.

skip.description: Remove a shared semantic rule on one side. e.g. { frontend: ['max'] } drops the max-length check on the FE.

ui.description: Per-field UI hints. All optional; widget defaults are inferred from type+format.

widget.description: Override the default widget. e.g. 'textarea' for a string field.

type.description: Cardinality. belongsTo is NOT here — declare via foreignId field instead.

foreignKey.description: FK column name override. Defaults to Laravel convention.

fields.description: Field names in the order they appear in the form. Omitted fields are excluded.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: just a field name (or dotted path like 'category.name').

defaultSort.description: Default sort. Prefix '-' for descending. e.g. '-created_at'.

subtitle.description: Field shown as card subtitle. Supports dotted paths.

body.description: Fields shown in the card body.
